CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Contents (color-labeled coordinate sets), their presentation (current vs candidate listings), and origin/status metadata are all explicitly given for the same referents and times.

A.rationale: No text links attention/allocation or processing condition to content presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with color attributes and coordinate sets are listed.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is provided separately from the identified content sets, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report explicitly states how contents are presented as organized coordinate sets (current and candidate listings).
